verdict.rationale: Greptile documents dashboard-level settings that act as defaults, which a per-repo greptile.json can override, plus directory-scoped settings. That gives a defaults-plus-overrides model. However, the evidence never states that dashboard settings are org-wide defaults applied across many repos. Exceptions are managed in each repo's greptile.json rather than centrally. Missing for 10: explicit org-wide default policy across hundreds of repos, a central exceptions/override management view, independent corroboration at scale.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I roll out org-level review defaults across hundreds of repos and manage exceptions centrally

citations.quote: Settings are read from the source branch of the PR and override dashboard settings.
Scope review settings, rules, and context to the directories each team owns.
Control review behavior, PR filters, file patterns, custom context, and output formatting.
